git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add weekly subscription support

- Add CYCLE.WEEK for weekly billing cycles (charging every 7 days)
- Weekly plans cost price × 52 ÷ 12 per month, rounded down to nearest cent
- Support --every week option in CLI (also --every weekly)
- Update renewals sorting to use date instead of label for correct ordering
- Update export to use monthlyCents function for consistent calculations
- Add comprehensive tests for weekly cycle behavior
EOF
)" -u

   - Added `week`/`weekly` to the `--every` option
